heading: ஆங்கில மொழிபெயர்ப்பு
lines: If ever such a place be given
As gift, I will not go from her
Whose jewels glitter, and whose hair
Is dark and long. Farewell, O heart!
The lonely way more dreadful seems
Than javelins aimed against his foes.
Her broad and tender shoulders feel
E'en sweeter than his sceptered sway.
